What I do well

Core expertise

Two decades of fieldwork, review, and research, spanning conventional E&P and the energy transition.

◈

Seismic Interpretation & Inversion

Reading 2D and 3D seismic data to work out what rock layers look like below the surface, and where resources might sit.

▦

Reservoir Characterisation

Building a clear, static picture of a reservoir's rock properties, so drilling and development decisions rest on solid ground.

⛰

Basin & Petroleum Systems

Studying how a sedimentary basin formed over millions of years, to understand where resources are likely to sit today.

◔

Probabilistic Volumetrics

Estimating how much oil or gas a field might hold, using Monte Carlo methods for a clear range rather than a single guess.

▨

Geostatistical Modelling

Using kriging and sequential Gaussian simulation to fill the gaps between well data points in a 3D model.

❄

CCS, Hydrogen & Geothermal

Assessing whether rock formations can safely store CO₂, and exploring natural hydrogen and geothermal potential.

✦

AI/ML for Geoscience & Petroleum Data

Building machine-learning models — currently crude assay prediction — that connect subsurface and petrophysical data to commercial decisions, in Python.

▤

FDP Review & Risk Analysis

Critically reviewing field development plans, and running Monte Carlo and scenario-based risk analysis before big investment decisions.

◎

Team Leadership & Mentoring

Leading multidisciplinary technical teams of up to 12, and mentoring geoscientists earlier in their careers.

Software: Petrel RE · DecisionSpace · Hampson-Russell · Kingdom Suite · SKUA · Techlog · Interactive Petrophysics · ArcGIS/QGIS · Python · GemPy (dev.)

Frontier basins · DGH

Opening three frontier basins

Challenge
Almost no wells and mostly regional 2D seismic. Where could a working petroleum system exist?
Approach
Sequence-stratigraphic and paleo-structural frameworks from National Seismic Programme data; source, reservoir, seal and trap mapped for each system tract.
Result
Five Ganga leads (223–940 km²) and three blocks proposed; Andaman tectonic framework revised; Chhattisgarh plays identified. Acreage offered with a clear geological story.

Kalol reservoir, Cambay Basin · Ph.D.

Finding good reservoir between five wells

Challenge
Thin, shifting channel sands, five wells with basic logs and one dry well.
Approach
Multi-litho Attribute-Based Inversion (a neural network linking seismic attributes to rock properties), spectral decomposition and geostatistical modelling.
Result
Four reservoir classes in 3D; new targets away from wells; a blind test on withheld wells matched. Published in The Leading Edge and Petroleum Geoscience.
Seismic inversionGeostatisticsStatic modellingUncertainty

Conceptual model · three pays, separate contacts, permeability barrier

Oil-in-place maps for each pay and combined

Mumbai Offshore, D-18 block

Modelling a complex carbonate field

Challenge
Carbonate quality changes quickly; three pays have separate contacts and a permeability barrier.
Approach
3D seismic RMS amplitude used to extract geo-bodies, which guide facies and property models.
Result
Separate oil-in-place maps for each pay, then combined: a direct input to well placement.

Ten working applications, built on domain knowledge

Each tool started with a slow or error-prone task in daily work. They run as single files in the browser, offline, and data never leaves the user's computer.

Artificial intelligence · crude evaluation

Crude assay prediction with machine learning

A full assay takes weeks, but buying and blending decisions are needed within days. The tool learns from the historical assay database, lets four models compete for each property, tests them on crudes they have not seen, and shows a confidence score and approximate 95% range beside every value.

9 routine tests in12 properties outLeave-one-out validation
Laboratory quality control

Crude Assay QC Desk

Checks every assay workbook against physical laws (mass balance, additivity, boiling-point order and physical limits) and gives one score and one verdict, before errors reach refinery planning.

43 checks9 physical principles
Automated reporting

Automated crude assay report generation

Turns checked workbooks into the standard crude evaluation report, with each value traced to its source sheet and revisions compared automatically.

Minutes, not daysWord · web · PDF
Refinery decision support

Crude Evaluation Scorecard

Scores a crude against unit specifications and gives a fit score, a grade from A to D and constraints ranked by impact, each explained as blend, re-route or treat.

41 parameters11 processing areas
Energy transition

Natural hydrogen screening platform

Builds a gridded structural and thermal model, screens generation, migration, trapping and leakage, and estimates hydrogen in place. Every input is tagged as measured, assumed, calculated or simulated.

An annual cash-flow model with royalty, government revenue share and income tax that gives a plain-word verdict: worth pursuing, marginal or not attractive. Screenshot uses built-in sample data.

Looking ahead

Where I want to go next

In exploration, a prospect is an area you haven't drilled yet but believe holds something worth finding. These are mine.

Taking AI/ML further

My crude-assay prediction work at HPCL is a first step. Next, I want to build machine-learning and agentic AI tools for real geological modelling — reasoning through a subsurface problem the way a geoscientist would.

Open, accessible subsurface tools

Contributing to open-source projects like GemPy and GemGIS, so geoscientists without expensive software can still build solid 3D models.

A research role in Europe, anchored in Germany

Seeking a research, postdoctoral, or senior industry role in Europe — with Germany as my anchor location — working on CCS, geothermal, and hydrogen research.

Programming as a core skill

Bringing my Python up to a level where I can build tools for other geoscientists, not just use the tools that exist.
